title: Service Providers
subtitle: Manage service runtime endpoints, OpenAPI discovery sources, verification rules, and versioned auth contracts. Connections then bind environments and credentials.
syncTitleNoDoc: No OpenAPI document configured; auto-sync unavailable. Connections and runtime calls are unaffected.
syncTitleManual: Discovery is set to “Off”; switch to on-demand to enable sync.
syncTitleOk: Sync capabilities from the OpenAPI document
assetsHintWithDoc: After syncing OpenAPI, materialize endpoints as Tool Drafts.
assetsHintNoDoc: No online document configured; auto-discovery is off. Existing assets can still be viewed and materialized.
noAssetsSyncFirst: No assets yet. Sync the Provider first.
noAssetsContinue: No assets yet. You can still create a Connection with this Provider; sync capabilities later when a document is available.
emptyBody: Register a runtime endpoint and auth contract first. You can add an OpenAPI document later, then create a service connection.
noMatchBody: Try different search keywords or status filters.
loadFailed: Failed to load Providers. Please try again.
syncDisabledNote: {name} does not have OpenAPI auto-discovery enabled. Connections and runtime calls are unaffected.
saveFailed: Failed to save Provider. Check the endpoint and auth contract.
deleteFailed: Delete failed. Check related Connections and Tools first.
sectionServiceDiscoveryHint: The runtime URL is used for Tool calls. The OpenAPI document is only for auto-discovery and sync; it does not affect Connections or runtime calls.
serviceBaseUrlHint: Base URL used for live calls. Do not put the OpenAPI document path here.
documentUrlHint: Only used for auto-discovery and capability sync. Leave empty if the third party has no online document—you can still save the Provider, create Connections, and run live calls.
allowedCidrsHint: Only private or loopback addresses need an explicit allowlist (one CIDR per line). Leave empty for public URLs; a single IPv4 host can use /32.
sectionVerificationHint: Connection verification issues a safe request against the runtime URL using these rules.
sectionIdentityHint: Choose the identity modes this Provider supports (multi-select). When creating a Connection, pick exactly one supported mode. Shared accounts and no-auth are not supported.
legacyAuthNote: Legacy service-auth contract detected. Saving hard-cuts to {schema}; select at least one mode and complete required fields.
modeBrokerDesc: The platform exchanges a short-lived business token for the current user identity
modePassthroughDesc: The caller supplies a token for this request only; the platform uses it once and never stores it
allowedScopesHint: Space- or comma-separated; the Connection scope must be within this allowlist.
brokerHelp: The platform authenticates to the Broker with private_key_jwt; only USER subjects are supported today.
passthroughHelp: Accepts Access Tokens only. Callers provide a token and expiry each time; the platform never writes them to sessions, history, or local storage.
techTokenBoundary: User business tokens never enter Provider / Connection config, logs, local storage, session history, or Revisions.
deleteBody: After deleting {name}, sync will no longer work; existing Connections and Tools may also stop working.
deleteConfirmLabel: Type the Provider name to confirm
oauthClientSecretHelp: Plaintext is only used when creating or replacing a Secret.
validationServiceBaseUrl: Enter an HTTP(S) runtime URL without query or fragment.
validationDocumentUrl: OpenAPI document URL is not a valid HTTP(S) URL; leave empty if there is no online document.
validationDiscoveryNeedsDoc: On-demand discovery requires an OpenAPI document URL; choose “Auto-discovery off” if there is no online document.
validationVerificationPath: Verification path must be relative to the Provider runtime URL.
validationExpectedStatuses: Expected status codes must be unique comma-separated numbers from 100–599.
validationCidr: Allowed private CIDR format is invalid; IPv4 example: 192.168.10.0/24.
validationPrivateAddress: Private runtime address {address} must be explicitly allowlisted (you can use {cidr}).
validationInjectionHeader: Business token injection header name is invalid.
validationBrokerEndpoint: Enter a valid Broker Token Endpoint.
